name: FC Augsburg
identity_summary: Augsburg's civic club. Local and modest, without a strongly documented football ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1907. Stay near 4 except city. Current table ignored.

name: Mainz 05
identity_summary: Mainz's carnival-city club. Civic first, without a locked playing idea across eras.
source_quality_notes: Founded 16 Mar 1905. Klopp-era press is a coach era, so M2 stays 4. Civic Mainz is the safe move.

name: Union Berlin
identity_summary: Eisern Union. An East Berlin club defined by its support more than by a playing idea.
source_quality_notes: Founded 20 Jan 1966 from TSC Berlin, roots 1906 (fc-union-berlin.de). Eisern nickname, Dynamo rivalry, Alte Forsterei are documented. Not a second St Pauli: stay off 7s. Do not invent chants. Current Bundesliga years ignored.

name: Borussia Monchengladbach
identity_summary: The Foals. A Rhineland civic club still carrying the 1970s as memory more than as present power.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1 Aug 1900. 1970s titles are an era, so H1 stays 4. Fohlen attacking memory is light (M1/M2 at 5, confidence 1). Civic Rhineland is safer.

name: Hamburger SV
identity_summary: Hamburg's dinosaur. A Hanseatic giant that treated the Bundesliga as home until it was not.
source_quality_notes: Club statute traces origin to SC Germania, 29 Sep 1887; present HSV 1919 (Wikipedia). Never-relegated identity broke in 2018, so H1 is 5 for the fall from certainty. Derby: St Pauli.

name: 1. FC Koln
identity_summary: Cologne's billy-goat club. Carnival city, loud support, belonging before a single playing idea.
source_quality_notes: Founded 13 Feb 1948. Geissbock mascot and civic Cologne/carnival identity are documented. H2 at 6 is the volatile matchday read. Playing ideology not locked.

name: Werder Bremen
identity_summary: Bremen's green-and-white civic club. The city on the Weser comes before a locked style.
source_quality_notes: Founded 4 Feb 1899. Civic Hanseatic Bremen is the safe read. Schaaf-era football ignored as a coach era.

name: Schalke 04
identity_summary: A mining-city club from Gelsenkirchen. Working-class Ruhr identity outlasted the league place.
source_quality_notes: Founded 4 May 1904. Koenigsblau / Knappen mining identity is the documented story. Revierderby with Dortmund. Current division ignored. H1 at 5 is the fallen-giant read, not yo-yo as identity.

name: SV Elversberg
identity_summary: A Saarland village club. Small-town scale is the identity, not a documented ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1907 as FC Germania Elversberg. Promotion years ignored. H3/S1 only.

name: SC Paderborn
identity_summary: Paderborn's civic club. Local and modest, without a strongly documented football ideology.
source_quality_notes: Lineage 1907; modern SC often dated via later mergers. Stay near 4 except city. Table position ignored.

name: Angers
identity_summary: A civic club from Angers. Local in scale, without a locked playing idea.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1919. Stay near 4 except city.

name: AJ Auxerre
identity_summary: A small-city youth club. Guy Roux's long academy idea is the identity, not the present table.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1905 as Association de la Jeunesse Auxerroise. Roux's uninterrupted 1964-2000 spell and the production of internationals are documented (Wikipedia). M3 at 7 is the academy read. Current division ignored.

name: Stade Brestois
identity_summary: A port club from Brest. Breton and civic, without a strongly documented ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1950. Recent European season ignored. S1 civic Brittany/port is the safe move.

name: Le Havre
identity_summary: Le Club Doyen. France's oldest football story, a Norman port club that treats history as the point.
source_quality_notes: Club site claims 1872; independent accounts date the sports club 1884 and football 1894 (Wikipedia). Nickname Club Doyen is documented either way. S2 at 7 is the oldest-club heritage read.

name: Le Mans
identity_summary: Le Mans' civic club. Local, and younger as a modern entity than the city's name suggests.
source_quality_notes: Modern Le Mans FC commonly dated 1985 after earlier city sides. Stay near 4 except locality. S2 at 3 is a light modern-entity read, confidence 1.

name: RC Lens
identity_summary: A mining-country club. The Sang et Or belong to the pit towns, not to a capital.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1906. Mining / northern working-class identity is widely documented. Derby du Nord with Lille. Current table ignored.

name: LOSC Lille
identity_summary: Lille's northern club. Civic Flanders first, with a later reputation for growing players.
source_quality_notes: Present LOSC from a 1944 wartime merger. Derby with Lens. Academy/title years are thinner as enduring ideology, so M3 is 5 confidence 1. Civic north is safer.

name: FC Lorient
identity_summary: A Breton port club from Lorient. Civic and coastal, without a locked ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1926. Stay near 4 except city/Brittany.

name: Olympique Lyon
identity_summary: Lyon's modern aristocrat. Seven straight titles made winning feel normal, then the ground shifted.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1950. Seven Ligue 1 titles 2002-08 are the enduring winning mark, so H1 is 2. Academy is known but secondary here (M3 5, confidence 1). Current ownership ignored.

name: AS Monaco
identity_summary: A principality club. Talent is bought and moved on. The place is not a French civic town.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1924. Plays in Ligue 1 from a city-state. Acquisition model and low-tax location are the documented difference from civic French clubs. Not a neighbourhood cause. Current owners ignored as an era.
